problems: The claimed start time is 20:00, but the quoted page says 'every Tuesday evening at 7.30pm' (19:30). No 8pm or 20:00 time appears anywhere in the evidence, so the stated start time is wrong. The quote itself, the venue, the weekly Tuesday schedule and the first-hand source all check out.
